copy.tagline: 管理 Flutter 应用中的状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在用 Flutter 开发应用时需要管理 UI 状态
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build Flutter apps and need to manage UI state

howto.what: Claude将遵循Flutter的ChangeNotifier模式进行状态管理：创建继承ChangeNotifier的模型并调用notifyListeners()，通过ChangeNotifierProvider提供，使用Consumer或Provider.of消费，并优化widget重建。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建或使用Flutter的ChangeNotifier状态管理时，例如创建模型、提供到widget树、消费状态或优化重建时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个CartModel类并实现添加和移除方法。
如何用Consumer在widget中显示购物车总价？

howto.what_en: Claude will follow Flutter's ChangeNotifier pattern for state management: create models extending ChangeNotifier and call notifyListeners(), provide them via ChangeNotifierProvider, consume state with Consumer or Provider.of, and optimize widget rebuilds.
howto.when_en: When you ask to set up or use Flutter ChangeNotifier state management, e.g., create models, provide to widget tree, consume state, or optimize rebuilds.

say_en.text: Create a CartModel class with add and remove methods.
say_en.note: Claude will generate model code with notifyListeners().

say_en.text: How to use Consumer to display cart total price?
How to optimize Provider rebuild performance?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest using listen: false and placing Consumer wisely.
